text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Suruhanjaya Koperasi
Malaysia (Tarikh Peletakhakan) 2015.

(2)  Perintah ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2008.

Tarikh peletakhakan

2. Menteri menetapkan 1 Januari 2008 sebagai tarikh peletakhakan bagi maksud
seksyen 5 Akta dan pada tarikh itu segala harta, hak dan liabiliti—

(a) Kerajaan Malaysia;

(b) Ketua Pendaftar Koperasi bagi Malaysia di bawah Akta Koperasi 1993
[Akta 502];

(c) Pendaftar Persatuan Nelayan di bawah Akta Persatuan Nelayan 1971
[Akta 44]; dan

(d) Pendaftar Pertubuhan Peladang di bawah Akta Pertub uhan
Peladang 1973 [Akta 109],

yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual hendaklah dipindahkan dan diletak hak pada
Suruhanjaya Koperasi Malaysia tanpa apa -apa pemindahhakan, penyerahhakan atau
pemindahan hakmilik.

MALAYSIA CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES COMMISSION ACT 2007

MALAYSIA CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES COMMISSION (VESTING DATE) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 5(1) of
the Malaysia Co-operative Societies Commission Act 2007 [ Act 665], the Minister makes
the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Malaysia Co -operative Societies
Commission (Vesting Date) Order 2015.

 (2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 1 January 2008.

Vesting date
2. The Minister appoints 1 January 2008 as the vesting date for the purpos es of
section 5 of the Act and on such date all properties, rights and liabilities of—

(a) the Government of Malaysia;

(b) the Registrar General of Co -operative Societies for Malaysia under the
Co-operative Societies Act 1993 [Act 502];

(c) the Registra r of Fishermen's Associations under the Fishermen's
Associations Act 1971 [Act 44]; and

(d) the Registrar of  Farmers' Organizations under the Farmers'
Organization Act 1973 [Act 109],

specified in the Schedule shall be transferred to and be vested in the Malaysia
Co-operative Societies Commission without any conveyance, assignment or transfer.
